content:
A Laredo man has pleaded guilty to murder in the 2022 fatal shooting of a 32-year-old outside a West Del Mar Boulevard bar, closing a case that stretched across the border and back, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Jesus Guadalupe Covarrubias pleaded guilty to murder on Oct. 15 in the 111th District Court, before Judge Monica Z. Notzon, after waiving his right to a jury trial. The sentence followed an agreed recommendation, the Times reported.

Covarrubias was sentenced to 15 years in the Texas Department of Criminal Justice, with credit for time served since March 2023. The sentence will run concurrently with his federal firearms case.

The victim, Daniel Arroyo, 32, was fatally shot at about 3:30 a.m. on Dec. 23, 2022, outside 360 Bar & Patio on West Del Mar Boulevard in Laredo. Laredo police identified Covarrubias as a suspect and later as the prime suspect, according to the Times.

After the shooting, Covarrubias fled to Tamaulipas and then to Mexico City, where he was arrested in January 2023. His indictment was filed Feb. 1, 2023.
